sources.scope: Public parcel outlines from Nairobi Maps, a commercial publisher. Sampled local coverage only; source registry numbers, ownership and official government lineage are not supplied. Application references identify geometry versions and change when boundaries change.
sources.attribution: Nairobi Maps — public parcel outlines; application references derived from geometry. Registry numbers and ownership unavailable.
sources.licenceNote: Provider permits personal, educational and non-commercial viewing/searching with attribution. Bulk or commercial use requires written permission. Source terms are informational; the live service also applies anonymous preview-area limits.
caveats: Commercial survey-record compilation; not an official registry. Source lineage and update dates are not independently verified.
Public geometry responses have empty properties and no source IDs; no paid attributes or WFS credentials are used.

Application identity uses source namespace plus canonical geometry SHA-256 at 1e-7-degree precision, a version marker and a spatial locator. Ring order and start vertex do not change the identity. Consecutive duplicate coordinates are removed during canonical encoding; no shapes are unioned or boundaries repaired.

Fresh exact reads locate the source outline spatially and verify its complete hash. A changed outline does not inherit the old reference. Absence means that geometry version was not returned, not that a legal parcel ceased to exist.
The anonymous viewport response must report matching count, fixed zoom 19 and truncated=false, with count below its reported limit. Errors, quotas and incomplete responses remain errors.

Observed viewport selection uses intersecting envelopes and returns whole polygons, including some that do not topologically intersect the rectangle. Footprint reads apply an exact geometry intersection filter.
